notes.title: Part of You 1.1 Release!
notes.notes:
HOOOOOOOO WEEEE!

It's been a long time coming, but welcome to 1.1! Does it have everything we wanted in it? No. Does it have a heck of a lot of cool new stuff?! Absolutely! 

1.1 brings a bunch of content that was cut from the initial release that we just didn't have time to finish up & lots & lots of bug fixes & optimization. So what does this update actually have?


NO NEW CHARACTERS
Is what we might have said if we were sane. Instead we have added 11 new characters and piles and piles of dialogue to the game. Like honestly, I am personally baffled why we keep doing this to ourselves. You might ask us, why would you add this amount of content to a game a year after it launched when nobody is playing it? Uhhhhh. Next question.


Achievements
The original vision for the game had a lot more achievements and jokes we really couldn't cram into the initial release. This patch attempts to rectify that, adding a bunch of new achievements & interactions that really should have been there from the start. 


Performance
While our game does have Ray Tracing, it really should be able to run on just about anything. When the game first launched however, it required a super computer to play at a stable frame rate. One of the major focuses of this update was to really make sure our game could run on anything and we are a lot closer to that than we were before.


Future Stuff
A couple of fun things to highlight with the release of 1.1.



We have been working on making the game more performant for a few reasons, but one of the biggest questions we were asked in the last year is:

IS PART OF YOU STEAM DECK COMPATIBLE?



[strike]The short answer is yes[/strike]. While we aren't officially verified yet, it is something that is actively being worked on and we should have that squared away within a few weeks! It mostly works right now... mostly.


Too Many Games
Are you in the Philadelphia area? Do you wanna come meet us, buy merch, or maybe just play the game at a con? That sounds dope to us! Come see us at TooManyGames June 27-29!
https://toomanygames.com/


Indiepocalypse & Physical Release
With the release of 1.1 we are also sitting down with Andrew of Indiepocalypse to chat about indie games and whatever other weird stuff comes up. With this, Part of You will also be getting a physical release, something we are all stoked about. More news to come on this in the coming weeks.
https://pizzapranks.com/


Sale! 
Do you wanna pick up Part of You on discount? Now (might be a few hours from now) through early July, the game is going to be on sale for 10$, so make sure to pickup a copy for a friend!



That's all from us for now, but I'm sure there will be more soon!

Till then, you can always come hang out with us on discord or report your game breaking bugs and watch me mentally fall apart in real time. It's a lot of fun! 
https://discord.gg/5WSzqbsT9e

A very special thank you to our community for being patient the last few months as we put this update together. We love you all and cannot wait for y'all to see the new stuff we have added!

notes.title: Game Release Details
notes.notes:
Howdy folks,

Just wanted to throw a number of updates here about the release today. Just wanted to throw a huge thank you to anybody who has wishlisted the game, tested it, streamed it, shared it with friends, or even just clicked on it. We have met a number of you at PAX East and it feels right to be dropping this game from the show floor with so many of you. This has been a 4 year journey, none of us on the team had any idea what we were getting into when we started this, and honestly, I don't think any of us do at this point either, hours away from release. Thank you again.

With all that out of the way, let's talk logistics. The game should be coming out around 5 EST today, we think. If it isn't out by then, there will definitely be a new announcement. The game is coming out today, so don't worry about that. We are just hard at work making sure that there are as few bugs as possible. Unquestionably there will be.

If you do run into bugs, please come show them to us, either here on the steam page or over on our discord (linked at the bottom). We will try and wipe them out as fast as possible.

Saving is a little buggy right now, so sorry in advance for that. If you do run into issues with loading the game, one of the things we might ask you for if you do run into issues is your save file, that will super help.

Please leave a review of the game (even if its a bad one). It will help us get seen on steam and also see what we need to fix with the game. I hope to be as responsive in the coming weeks with bugfixes, updates on our end, and improvements to the game. I cannot wait to see what y'all do with this one.

See ya soon!

Tom
Team Sometimes Y

Discord Server

notes.title: Just a little update
notes.notes:
Howdy folks,

This is our first time using this feature, so bear with us as we get used to whatever this is! Just wanted to drop something here because we know a lot of folks have been looking forward to the game for a long time. We aren't dead, in fact, we are probably better than ever. This year marked our first year of full time production, meaning the game is really starting to shape up and look how we wanted it to. Dozens of new characters, a couple new locations, many many new puzzles, and all kinds of silly goofs have all been put into the build. 

Not everything you see in this post is going to make it into the final game, but we did want to let you all know that we are still working very hard on the game. Hopefully more news to come about the future of the project soon, but no promises. 

In other news, we also made a whole other game in the last few months that you can check out and play right now for FREE!

Click here for the Steam Link

Other than that, expect more from us generally in the coming months as we work on the game and have more to share. If you have the time please get your people to wishlist and share our game, you have no idea how much that means to us, even a single wishlist is like a huge deal when it comes to visibility and traction, so if you don't mind having another game on there, we would be eternally grateful. 

Okay, that's all from us at Team Sometimes Y, have a great Tuesday!
